exposure: dynamic positive end-expiratory pressure (PEEP) up to 15 cmH2O
outcome: incidence of mechanical ventilation (MV) < 72 h of life
mean duration of MV < 72 h of life
administration of a 2nd dose of surfactant
cohort: 163 very low gestational age infants (VLGAI) < 32 weeks' gestation requiring respiratory support beyond a continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) = 5 cmH2O
finding: Combining two individualized lung recruitment maneuvers at birth was feasible and may be beneficial on short-term and before discharge pulmonary outcomes in very low gestational age infants.
